governance.note: This run RETIRES a fitted lever rather than adding one: the PJM pumped-storage $10/MWh dispatch adder (PUMPED_STORAGE_DISPATCH_ADDER_BY_ISO) is removed. It had been fitted 2026-06-10 to a mis-measured target (the EIA-923 PS *net*-generation magnitude ~2.6 TWh, the round-trip loss, read as gross discharge); per CLAUDE.md #12 a lever tuned to a mis-measured residual with no forward analogue is inadmissible, so it is retired and PJM PS now arbitrages on its physical RTE 0.80 like every other storage resource. Remaining active levers all trace to measured inputs: measured F923 ISO-monthly delivered gas, CAMPD unit-outage overlay (outage_source=historic), EIA-860 fleet + retiree CEMS envelope, measured EIA-923 Sch-5 coal take-or-pay sunk-fuel share, measured online-net-MW coal synchronization Pmin. No residual-tuned adders; no pinning to actuals; PS dispatch is free arbitrage on the physical RTE. See docs/multi-iso/pjm-ps-cycling-diagnosis-2026-06.md.

The reconciled-actual agreement is evidence only and is NOT injected into the scorer as a synthetic actual.
